tweets.text:
I used Fable 5 to port Command & Conquer: Generals Zero Hour to the iPhone and iPad!

This is the actual 2003 engine compiled for ARM64 natively, no emulator.

Campaign, skirmish, Generals Challenge all work with touch controls built for an RTS.

Open sourcing it all below!

tweets.author: @dr_cintas
tweets.text:
This shouldn't be free.

A team has open sourced a fully local AI meeting notetaker that replaces Otter, Fireflies, and Fathom in one Rust app.

It's called Meetily. Every meeting gets recorded, transcribed, and summarized entirely on your own machine. Zero cloud. Zero API calls
